DocsConfig.title: Docs Config
DocsConfig.description: DocsConfig defines configuration overrides for project documentation. It inherits from the parent project and can only override specific fields. Stored in [project]/docs/config.yml (in the version/branch specified by project config) Example: HENA/docs/config.yml in main branch or v2.0.0 tag  Docs inherit everything from parent project by default. Only fields defined here can be overridden.
